import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static int n, t;
    static char[][] nau = new char[10][10];
    static char[][] pom = new char[10][10];
    static int[][] odl = new int[10][10];
    static boolean[][][][][] moge = new boolean[60][10][10][10][10];

    static int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1, 0};

    static boolean inside(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                nau[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                pom[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        // init odl
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                odl[i][j] = 1000;

        // find start
        int sx = -1, sy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (nau[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                }

        // BFS
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        odl[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                if (inside(nx, ny) && Character.isDigit(nau[nx][ny]) && odl[nx][ny] == 1000) {
                    odl[nx][ny] = odl[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        // init moge
        for (int k = 0; k < 60; k++)
            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++)
                    for (int l = 0; l < 10; l++)
                        for (int m = 0; m < 10; m++)
                            moge[k][i][j][l][m] = false;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                for (int d = 0; d < 5; d++) {
                    int ni = i + dx[d], nj = j + dy[d];
                    if (inside(ni, nj) && Character.isDigit(nau[i][j]) && Character.isDigit(nau[ni][nj]))
                        moge[0][i][j][ni][nj] = true;
                }

        for (int k = 0; k <= t - 2; k++)
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++)
                        for (int m = 0; m < n; m++) {
                            if (!moge[k][i][j][l][m]) continue;
                            for (int d = 0; d < 5; d++) {
                                int nl = l + dx[d], nm = m + dy[d];
                                if (inside(nl, nm) && Character.isDigit(nau[nl][nm]) && odl[l][m] >= k+2 && odl[nl][nm] >= k+2)
                                    moge[k+1][i][j][nl][nm] = true;
                            }
                        }

        // collect digits
        List<int[]> a = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (Character.isDigit(nau[i][j]))
                    a.add(new int[]{i, j});

        int V = 2 * a.size() + 2;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> G = new ArrayList<>(V);
        for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) G.add(new ArrayList<>());

        // source/sink edges
        for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
            int cap1 = nau[a.get(i)[0]][a.get(i)[1]] - '0';
            addEdge(G, 0, i+1, cap1);
            int cap2 = pom[a.get(i)[0]][a.get(i)[1]] - '0';
            addEdge(G, a.size()+1+i, V-1, cap2);
        }

        // middle edges
        for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < a.size(); j++) {
                boolean reach = false;
                for (int k = 0; k <= t-1; k++)
                    if (moge[k][a.get(i)[0]][a.get(i)[1]][a.get(j)[0]][a.get(j)[1]]) {
                        reach = true;
                        break;
                    }
                if (reach) {
                    addEdge(G, i+1, a.size()+1+j, 1000);
                }
            }

        // max flow (Edmonds-Karp)
        int flow = 0;
        while (true) {
            boolean[] vis = new boolean[V];
            int[] par = new int[V];
            int[] pedge = new int[V];
            Arrays.fill(par, -1);
            Queue<Integer> qq = new LinkedList<>();
            vis[0] = true;
            qq.add(0);
            while (!qq.isEmpty()) {
                int u = qq.poll();
                for (int ei = 0; ei < G.get(u).size(); ei++) {
                    Edge e = G.get(u).get(ei);
                    if (!vis[e.to] && e.cap > 0) {
                        vis[e.to] = true;
                        par[e.to] = u;
                        pedge[e.to] = ei;
                        qq.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (par[V-1] == -1) break;

            int add = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int v = V-1; v != 0; v = par[v]) {
                int u = par[v];
                Edge e = G.get(u).get(pedge[v]);
                add = Math.min(add, e.cap);
            }

            for (int v = V-1; v != 0; v = par[v]) {
                int u = par[v];
                Edge e = G.get(u).get(pedge[v]);
                e.cap -= add;
                G.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += add;
            }
            flow += add;
        }

        System.out.println(flow);
        sc.close();
    }

    static void addEdge(ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> G, int from, int to, int cap) {
        G.get(from).add(new Edge(to, G.get(to).size(), cap));
        G.get(to).add(new Edge(from, G.get(from).size() - 1, 0));
    }
}
